entries.title: Psalms 100:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of thanksgiving.>> Shout aloud unto Jehovah, all the earth!

entries.title: Psalms 100:2
segments: Serve Jehovah with joy: come before his presence with exultation.

entries.title: Psalms 100:3
segments: Know that Jehovah is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; [we are] his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

entries.title: Psalms 100:4
segments: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving [and] into his courts with praise; give thanks unto him, bless his name:

entries.title: Psalms 100:5
segments: For Jehovah is good; his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever; and his faithfulness from generation to generation.
